Exercise 1: Topic Vocabulary Matching 
Match each highlighted term with its correct definition: 
1. Learning analytics 
2. Algorithmic bias 
3. Differentiated learning pathways 
4. Affective computing 
5. Pedagogical quality 
A. Emotional recognition technologies used in machines 
B. Unequal outcomes produced by flawed data-based systems 
C. The academic effectiveness of teaching methods 
D. Tailored instructional routes based on students' needs 
E. Data-driven evaluations of learners' performance 
Exercise 2: Fill in the Blanks (Advanced Noun Phrases) 
Use the highlighted noun phrases to complete the sentences: 
1. Schools increasingly rely on __________ to monitor student progress 
in real time. 
2. Teachers fear that __________ may threaten fairness in assessment 
systems. 
3. Many experts argue that robots struggle to maintain high 
__________ when dealing with diverse learners. 
4. AI-powered platforms help create __________ for students with 
varying abilities. 
5. Researchers are expanding __________ to improve emotional 
responsiveness in robots. 
Exercise 3: Paraphrasing Task 
Rewrite the sentences using academic expressions from the text: 
1. Robot teachers always deliver the same quality of lessons. 
2. Human teachers understand students in ways robots cannot. 
3. Using robots too much might damage students' communication skills. 
4. There are ethical dangers in collecting a lot of learner data. 
5. Robot-based instruction can boost students' curiosity.
